They were dedicated to the gods and goddesses, particularly Aphrodite, the goddess of love. The name Blas, derived from the Greek word 'blazein', symbolizes the beauty and vitality of a flower coming into bloom.

Many believe that St. Blaise had the power to heal throats, particularly during times of illness or infection. As such, he is the patron saint of throats and is often invoked in prayers for relief from sore throats and other throat-related afflictions. The name Blas carries a spiritual significance of purity, protection, and healing, particularly for those who face challenges in the areas of communication, creativity, and self-expression.
